EC2: Treatment with IV antibiotics in the 6 weeks prior to Visit 1
EC3: Admission to the intensive care unit [AND] for current pulmonary exacerbation in the two weeks prior to Visit 2, [NOT] unless admission was due to a desensitization protocol
EC4: Pneumothorax in the two weeks prior to Visit 2
EC5: Primary diagnosis for current hospitalization is unrelated to worsening lower respiratory symptoms (e.g., pulmonary clean out [OR], distal intestinal obstruction syndrome (DIOS) [OR] , sinusitis)
EC6: Massive hemoptysis defined as > 250 cc in a 24 hour period  [OR] or 100 cc/day over 4 consecutive days occurring in the two weeks prior to Visit 2
EC7: Current pulmonary exacerbation [AND] thought to be due to allergic bronchopulmonary aspergillosis (ABPA)
EC8: At Visit 1, receiving ongoing treatment with a duration of more than 2 weeks with prednisone equivalent to >10mg/day
EC10: Receiving antimicrobial therapy to treat non-tuberculous mycobacterium (e.g., M. abscessus, M. avium complex) in the two weeks prior to Visit 2
